u1.q: — How was your vacation? — It ___ great!
u1.explain: 主语 It 为单数，一般过去时的 be 动词用 was。

u1.q: We ___ a lot of interesting things in the museum.
u1.explain: 描述过去发生的事，see 的过去式是 saw。

u1.q: Did she ___ her homework last night?
u1.explain: 助动词 did 后接动词原形 do。

u1.q: There was ___ in the classroom, so it was very quiet.
u1.explain: 教室很安静说明没有人，用 no one。

u1.q: Nothing ___ wrong with my computer.
u1.explain: 复合不定代词 nothing 作主语时视为单数，谓语用 is。

u1.q: I felt ___ because the trip was so boring.
u1.explain: 描述人的感受用 -ed 形容词 bored；boring 用于描述事物。

u1.q: The food there tasted ___.
u1.explain: taste 是系动词，后接形容词 delicious 作表语。

u1.q: ___ did you stay in Hainan? — For a week.
u1.explain: 回答是 For a week，表示一段时间，用 How long 提问。

u1.q: My sister ___ to bed early last night.
u1.explain: 时间状语 last night 表明用一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。

u1.q: We didn't ___ anything special last weekend.
u1.explain: didn't 后面必须接动词原形 do。

u1.q: It ___ rainy, so we stayed at home.
u1.explain: 后半句 stayed 是过去式，前半句也要用过去时 was。

u1.q: Can you tell me something ___ about your holiday?
u1.explain: 形容词修饰复合不定代词时要后置，且修饰事物用 interesting。

u1.q: — What did you do yesterday? — I ___ my homework and read a book.
u1.explain: 回答过去的事情用过去式 did。

u1.q: The past form of the verb 'take' is ___.
u1.explain: take 是不规则动词，过去式为 took，过去分词为 taken。

u1.q: Which sentences are correct simple past questions?
options: Did you visit the Palace Museum?
u1.explain: did 后必须用动词原形，所以 went 和 ate 都错误。

u1.q: Which pairs of past forms are correct?
u1.explain: fly 的过去式是 flew，不是 flied。

u1.q: Which words are indefinite pronouns?
u1.explain: slowly 是副词，其余三个都是复合不定代词。

u1.q: Which phrases describe vacation activities?
u1.explain: take the exam 是考试，不属于度假活动。

u1.q: In a negative sentence we usually use 'anything' instead of 'something'.
u1.explain: something 多用于肯定句，anything 多用于否定句和疑问句。

u1.q: The past form of 'buy' is 'buyed'.
u1.explain: buy 是不规则动词，过去式是 bought。

u1.q: 'Everyone' takes a plural verb, so we say 'Everyone are happy'.
u1.explain: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数，应说 Everyone is happy。

u1.q: 'Did' is followed by the base form of a verb, as in 'Did you see it?'.
u1.explain: 助动词 did 之后一律接动词原形。

u1.q: 'Nothing' already has a negative meaning, so we do not add 'not' again.
u1.explain: 英语中一般不用双重否定，nothing 本身即表否定。

u1.q: The word 'somewhere' can be used to talk about an unknown place.
u1.explain: somewhere 意为 '某个地方'，指不确定的地点。

u1.q: We ___ (go) to the beach and swam in the sea.
u1.explain: 与 swam 并列，同为一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。

u1.q: Did you see ___ (something / anything) interesting there?
u1.explain: 疑问句中通常用 anything。

u1.q: Nobody ___ (want / wants) to stay at home on such a fine day.
u1.explain: nobody 作主语时谓语动词用第三人称单数。

u1.q: The weather ___ (be) terrible during our trip.
u1.explain: weather 不可数且句子为过去时，用 was。

u1.q: There was ___ (nothing / anything) in the box. It was empty.
u1.explain: 盒子是空的，说明里面什么也没有，肯定句结构用 nothing。

u1.q: 写出动词 find 的过去式形式：___
u1.explain: find 是不规则动词，过去式和过去分词都是 found。

u2.q: — How often does he go swimming? — ___.
u2.explain: How often 问频率，答语要说明次数，如 twice a month。

u2.q: ___ hours do you sleep every night?
u2.explain: hours 是可数名词复数，用 How many 提问。

u2.q: How much ___ do you drink every day?
u2.explain: How much 后接不可数名词，water 不可数。

u2.q: She is ___ late for school; she is always on time.
u2.explain: 后句说她总是准时，说明从不迟到，用 never。

u2.q: ___ of the students in my class like reading.
u2.explain: 百分数表达为 数词 + percent，percent 不加 s。

u2.q: My eating habits are pretty ___.
u2.explain: 系动词 are 后接形容词作表语，用 healthy。

u2.q: Good food and exercise help me to ___.
u2.explain: to 后接动词原形 study，副词 better 修饰动词放在其后。

u2.q: It is good ___ your health to exercise every day.
u2.explain: 固定搭配 be good for，意为 '对……有益'。

u2.q: Here are the ___ of a student survey.
u2.explain: Here are 后接复数名词，用 results。

u2.q: ___ students watch TV every day — only about ten percent.
u2.explain: 只有约百分之十，表示 '很少'，修饰可数名词复数用 few。

u2.q: My father ___ goes to work by bike; he prefers walking.
u2.explain: 他更喜欢走路，说明几乎不骑车，用 hardly ever。

u2.q: How ___ time do you spend on homework every day?
u2.explain: time 表示 '时间' 时不可数，用 How much。

u2.q: Old habits ___ hard.
u2.explain: habits 是复数主语，一般现在时用动词原形 die。

u2.q: — ___ he exercise? — Yes, three times a week.
u2.explain: 主语 he 为第三人称单数，一般现在时的助动词用 Does。

u2.q: Which words are uncountable nouns?
u2.explain: apple 是可数名词，其余三个都不可数。

u2.q: Which are proper answers to a 'How often ...?' question?
u2.explain: Two hours 回答的是时间长度，属于 How long 的答语。

u2.q: Which sentences use 'how many' correctly?
options: How many books do you have?
How many milk do you drink?
u2.explain: water 和 milk 不可数，应改用 how much。

u2.q: Which of these are healthy habits?
options: sleeping about nine hours a night
u2.explain: 喝太多可乐不利健康。

u2.q: Adverbs of frequency are usually put before the main verb.
u2.explain: 如 He often plays football，频度副词位于实义动词之前。

u2.q: 'Hardly ever' means 'almost never'.
u2.explain: hardly ever 表示 '几乎从不'。

u2.q: We use 'How much' to ask about the number of countable nouns.
u2.explain: 可数名词的数量用 How many，How much 用于不可数名词。

u2.q: In the third person singular we say 'He exercise every day'.
u2.explain: 第三人称单数应为 He exercises every day。

u2.q: 'Twice a week' means two times in one week.
u2.explain: twice 意为两次，a week 表示每周。

u2.q: Junk food is good for our health, so we should eat it every day.
u2.explain: 垃圾食品对健康有害，应尽量少吃。

u2.q: How ___ (many / much) fruit do you eat every week?
u2.explain: fruit 表示 '水果' 总称时不可数，用 how much。

u2.q: He ___ (hardly / hard) ever eats junk food.
u2.explain: hardly ever 是固定搭配，意为 '几乎从不'。

u2.q: My mother is very ___ (health) and she exercises every day.
u2.explain: 系动词 is 后需要形容词 healthy。

u2.q: I watch TV three ___ (time) a week.
u2.explain: 表示次数时 time 是可数名词，three 后用复数 times。

u2.q: ___ (How often / How long) do you go to the library? — Once a month.
u2.explain: 答语 Once a month 表频率，用 How often 提问。

u2.q: Eating vegetables is good ___ your health.
u2.explain: be good for 意为 '对……有好处'。

u3.q: Lucy is ___ than Mary in class.
u3.explain: outgoing 是多音节形容词，比较级前加 more。

u3.q: My hair is ___ than yours.
u3.explain: than 前用比较级，单音节词直接加 -er。

u3.q: He works ___ than his brother.
u3.explain: 修饰动词 works 要用副词，其比较级为 more carefully。

u3.q: Which is ___, the sun or the moon?
u3.explain: 两者之间比较用比较级 bigger。

u3.q: Tom is not ___ his brother.
u3.explain: as ... as 之间用形容词原级，否定式为 not as tall as。

u3.q: A good friend is like a ___ — you can see yourself in him or her.
u3.explain: 课文名句：A good friend is like a mirror。

u3.q: She sings ___ better than I do.
u3.explain: much 可修饰比较级表示程度，very 不能修饰比较级。

u3.q: My sister is two years ___ than me.
u3.explain: than 前用比较级 older，前面可加具体差值 two years。

u3.q: The twins look ___, but they are different in character.
u3.explain: same 前必须加定冠词 the。

u3.q: It is ___ today than it was yesterday.
u3.explain: than 表示比较，cold 的比较级是 colder。

u3.q: Peter is more hard-working, ___ his brother is lazier.
u3.explain: while 表示前后对比，意为 '而'。

u3.q: Friends are like books — you don't need a lot of them ___ they are good.
u3.explain: as long as 意为 '只要'，引导条件状语从句。

u3.q: Who is ___, you or your sister?
u3.explain: 两人比较用比较级，quiet 的比较级是 quieter。

u3.q: My best friend is different ___ me.
u3.explain: be different from 意为 '与……不同'。

u3.q: Which comparatives are spelled correctly?
u3.explain: thin 需双写末尾辅音字母，正确形式是 thinner。

u3.q: Which sentences use 'as ... as' correctly?
options: He is as clever as his sister.
She runs as faster as me.
This book is as interesting as that one.
I am as tall than you.
u3.explain: as ... as 中间要用原级，且不能与 than 连用。

u3.q: Which words can describe a person's character?
u3.explain: yesterday 是时间名词，不能描述性格。

u3.q: Which are correct irregular comparative forms?
u3.explain: far 的比较级是 farther 或 further。

u3.q: For adjectives ending in a consonant plus y, we change y to i and add -er.
u3.explain: 如 happy — happier，funny — funnier。

u3.q: 'More outgoing' is the comparative form of 'outgoing'.
u3.explain: 多音节形容词的比较级在前面加 more。

u3.q: 'As ... as' should be used with the comparative form of an adjective.
u3.explain: as ... as 之间必须用形容词或副词的原级。

u3.q: 'Both' is used to talk about two people or things.
u3.explain: both 指两者都，三者及以上用 all。

u3.q: We can use 'much' or 'a lot' before a comparative to make it stronger.
u3.explain: much/a lot/even/far 都可修饰比较级。

u3.q: The comparative form of 'good' is 'gooder'.
u3.explain: good 是不规则变化，比较级是 better。

u3.q: This story is ___ (interesting) than that one.
u3.explain: interesting 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more interesting。

u3.q: She is not as ___ (outgoing) as her sister.
u3.explain: as ... as 之间保持原级形式。

u3.q: My brother is ___ (thin) than me.
u3.explain: 重读闭音节词双写末尾辅音字母再加 -er。

u3.q: ___ (All / Both) of my three friends like sports.
u3.explain: 三个人用 all，两个人才用 both。

u3.q: He speaks English ___ (good) than I do.
u3.explain: 此处修饰动词 speaks，well 的比较级是 better。

u3.q: 写出形容词 bad 的比较级形式：___
u3.explain: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst。

u4.q: Of all the students, Lily sings ___.
u4.explain: Of all 表示三者以上比较，副词 well 的最高级是 (the) best。

u4.q: This shop has the ___ prices in town.
u4.explain: in town 表示范围，用最高级 lowest。

u4.q: Which subject is ___, math, English or Chinese?
u4.explain: 三者比较用最高级 the easiest。

u4.q: Shanghai is one of the ___ cities in China.
u4.explain: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，big 的最高级是 biggest。

u4.q: You can buy clothes ___ at Miller's.
u4.explain: 修饰动词 buy 用副词最高级 the most cheaply。

u4.q: Talent shows are getting ___.
u4.explain: '越来越……' 的表达为 more and more + 多音节形容词。

u4.q: ___ is the most creative person in our group?
u4.explain: 询问人用 Who 作主语。

u4.q: Everyone has a chance ___ their best.
u4.explain: a chance to do sth. 表示 '做某事的机会'。

u4.q: The most important thing is ___ we all have fun.
u4.explain: that 引导表语从句，句中不作成分但不可省略。

u4.q: It is always fun ___ watch a good movie.
u4.explain: It is + 形容词 + to do sth. 结构，it 是形式主语。

u4.q: This cinema has the ___ seats of all.
u4.explain: 多音节形容词最高级前加 most，不能加 -est。

u4.q: — Which is ___, the red one or the blue one? — The blue one.
u4.explain: 两者选择比较用比较级 nicer。

u4.q: He is the ___ of the three boys.
u4.explain: 三者中比较用最高级 youngest。

u4.q: The superlative form of 'bad' is ___.
u4.explain: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst。

u4.q: Which superlative forms are correct?
u4.explain: good 的最高级是 the best，没有 goodest 这一形式。

u4.q: Which sentences are correct?
options: She is the tallest in her class.
He runs the fastest of all.
u4.explain: 第三句应为 This is the cheapest shop。

u4.q: Which phrases can describe a movie theater?
u4.explain: boring homework 与影院无关。

u4.q: Which are correct choice questions?
options: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
Who is taller, Tom or Jim?
Which is the best, A, B or C?
Do you like tea and coffee?
u4.explain: 选择疑问句用 or 连接选项，最后一项不能用 and。

u4.q: When we compare three or more things, we use the superlative form.
u4.explain: 三者及以上比较用最高级，两者比较用比较级。

u4.q: 'The most' is put before long adjectives to form the superlative.
u4.explain: 如 the most beautiful、the most popular。

u4.q: 'The most tallest building' is correct English.
u4.explain: most 与 -est 不能同时使用，应说 the tallest building。

u4.q: In the structure 'one of the + superlative', the noun must be plural.
u4.explain: 如 one of the best students，名词要用复数。

u4.q: In a choice question about two things, we can use a comparative form.
u4.explain: 如 Which is better, A or B? 两者比较用比较级。

u4.q: The superlative of 'far' can be 'farthest' or 'furthest'.
u4.explain: far 有两种变化：farther/farthest 和 further/furthest。

u4.q: Of all the shops, this one is the ___ (close) to my home.
u4.explain: 以 e 结尾的形容词最高级直接加 -st。

u4.q: He is one of the ___ (funny) actors in China.
u4.explain: 辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -est。

u4.q: This is the ___ (bad) film I have ever seen.
u4.explain: bad 的最高级是 worst，为不规则变化。

u4.q: She dances the ___ (beautiful) in our school.
u4.explain: 修饰动词 dances 用副词最高级 most beautifully。

u4.q: Which season do you like ___ (well)?
u4.explain: like ... best 意为 '最喜欢'，well 的最高级是 best。

u4.q: It is one of the tallest ___ (building) in the world.
u4.explain: one of the + 最高级后接可数名词复数。

u5.q: I hope ___ you again soon.
u5.explain: hope 后接动词不定式 to do。

u5.q: He doesn't mind ___ soap operas with his mother.
u5.explain: mind 后接动名词 doing。

u5.q: Which word means '纪录片'?
u5.explain: documentary 意为纪录片。

u5.q: — What do you think of talk shows? — I don't mind ___.
u5.explain: mind 后接宾格代词 them。

u5.q: Talent shows ___ becoming more and more popular.
u5.explain: 主语 Talent shows 为复数，用 are。

u5.q: I want to be a ___ so that I can tell people what is happening.
u5.explain: reporter 记者负责报道新闻。

u5.q: Mickey Mouse ___ in a cartoon in 1928.
u5.explain: 1928 是过去时间，用过去式 appeared。

u5.q: He was always ready ___ his friends.
u5.explain: be ready to do sth. 意为 '乐于/准备做某事'。

u5.q: ___ do you like about game shows?
u5.explain: like 后缺宾语，用 What 提问。

u5.q: I like to follow the news, so I watch it ___ night.
u5.explain: every night 意为 '每晚'，前面不加介词。

u5.q: She never ___ to be famous, but now everyone knows her.
u5.explain: but now 对比过去，前半句用过去式 expected。

u5.q: Do you want ___ with us tonight?
u5.explain: want to do sth. 是固定搭配。

u5.q: Some people think soap operas are ___ because they teach us nothing.
u5.explain: meaningless 意为 '无意义的'，符合句意。

u5.q: The cartoon is not only funny ___ also educational.
u5.explain: not only ... but also ... 是固定结构。

u5.q: Which of these are kinds of TV shows?
u5.explain: notebook 是笔记本，不是电视节目类型。

u5.q: Which sentences use the infinitive correctly?
options: They plan to have a party.
u5.explain: want 后应接 to go，第二句缺少 to。

u5.q: Which expressions show that you like something?
u5.explain: can't stand 表示无法忍受，don't mind 表示无所谓。

u5.q: Which words can describe a show you dislike?
u5.explain: wonderful 是褒义词，表示很棒。

u5.q: 'I don't mind it' means you neither like nor dislike it very much.
u5.explain: don't mind 表示中立态度，'无所谓'。

u5.q: After 'plan', 'hope' and 'decide' we use to + verb.
u5.explain: 这些动词后面都接动词不定式作宾语。

u5.q: 'Can't stand' means 'like very much'.
u5.explain: can't stand 意为 '无法忍受'，表示强烈不喜欢。

u5.q: A sitcom is a funny show about a group of people in the same place.
u5.explain: sitcom 即情景喜剧，人物固定、场景固定。

u5.q: Mickey Mouse is a famous cartoon character created by Walt Disney.
u5.explain: 米老鼠由沃尔特·迪士尼创造，是著名卡通形象。

u5.q: 'He wants go home' is correct English.
u5.explain: 应为 He wants to go home，want 后接不定式。

u5.q: I hope ___ (become) a reporter one day.
u5.explain: hope to do sth. 表示希望做某事。

u5.q: She wants ___ (find) out what is going on in the world.
u5.explain: want to do sth.，find out 意为 '查明'。

u5.q: Talent shows are getting more and more ___ (popular).
u5.explain: more and more 后接形容词原级。

u5.q: The show is not only funny but also ___ (education).
u5.explain: 与 funny 并列作表语，需用形容词 educational。

u5.q: I can't ___ (stand / standing) soap operas.
u5.explain: 情态动词 can't 后接动词原形 stand。

u5.q: Cartoons are ___ (main) made for children.
u5.explain: 修饰动词 made 要用副词 mainly。
